main_body: A chair seen in side profile (facing east): a tall backrest column on the right and an L-shaped seat with legs below. It reads as a side silhouette.
top_band: A light tan band about 2 rows tall at the seat (rows ~11-12). It is a thin edge of the seat in profile, not a horizontal surface seen from above. The top of the backrest is a small tan cap of 1-2 rows.
evidence: The chair is a side-profile L silhouette like the red 'side elevation chair' in the guide. The seat is only a thin 2px edge band, with dark legs below and a tall narrow backrest. No seat surface is visible from above, and there is no front-edge line, eave shadow or recessed front. A thin-seat fail.

style.evidence: The chair uses about 4 wood tones (light tan, orange, mid brown, dark brown) and the outline is a dark brown tinted to the wood, not near-black. It has some vertical shading on the backrest, but fewer steps than the references, and it has little grain or texture. The small silhouette is clean but thinner and less textured than the stall and well, so it is slightly lower in density.
